## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew build` passes locally (ktlint, lint, tests, apiCheck)

- [ ] Behavior changes covered by JUnit/Robolectric tests
- [ ] README / CHANGELOG updated where relevant
- [ ] Conventional commit messages
